bullets.text: Built a Delhi Metro route planner covering 250+ stations with dual optimization modes — BFS for fewest stops and a custom minimum-interchange pathfinder — across DMRC, Rapid Metro, and Airport Express lines.
Implemented official-style fare estimation with distance-based DMRC slabs, Rapid Metro premium fares, and Airport Express matrix pricing, including weekday and holiday rate handling.
Designed commute-focused mobile UX with fuzzy offline station search (Fuse.js), GPS nearest-station detection, live journey progress, saved quick routes, and adaptive light/dark themes.
Architected a modular TypeScript service layer for routing, fares, stations, and geo-location, with Redux Persist for local state and Firebase Remote Config for version-driven app update prompts.
